title: The WhataHotel Take: Four Seasons Orlando at Walt Disney World

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.text: Four Seasons Orlando at Walt Disney World is a AAA Five Diamond resort right on Disney property. The thing is, it's not only for Disney families.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.text: So it's more than a park base.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.text: Much more. But for families, Explorer Island is a heated five-acre water park with a lazy river and two slides. Kids For All Seasons is a complimentary daily camp for ages four to twelve.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.text: You get thirty minutes of Early Theme Park Entry daily, plus complimentary motor coaches. At night, Capa, the Spanish steakhouse, has a rooftop terrace with fireworks views.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.text: Oasis is an infinity-edge lakeside pool for twenty-one and over, and the spa has eighteen treatment rooms. Golfers get Tranquilo, a Tom Fazio course that's also a certified Audubon sanctuary.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.text: Two things to know. Magic Kingdom's about three miles away, and the coach drops you at the Ticket and Transportation Center for the monorail. And Capa held a Michelin star through 2025; it's now Michelin Recommended.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.text: Fair. And the kids' club stops at twelve, and Oasis is adults only.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.text: So book it for Disney with a real resort to come back to. Just don't expect to walk to the parks.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, you get free breakfast for two daily, a priority upgrade if available at check-in, and a $100 hotel credit.

short_version.best_for: Families doing Disney in luxury, plus couples and golfers
short_version.atmosphere: Five Diamond resort on Disney property with a five-acre water park
short_version.worth_knowing: Magic Kingdom is about three miles away by complimentary coach and monorail
